verdict.rationale: Canva documents Connect REST APIs, an MCP server, an Admin API and SCIM provisioning, but nothing in the evidence pack describes issuing API credentials with scopes or least-privilege permissions for an agent. Choosing which team members can use an app is a different control from scoping a credential, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
